verdict.rationale: Vercel's own GitHub README names choosing a template as a getting-started path, so the product does offer templates. The evidence is a single thin mention: it never documents one-click deploy, a template gallery, or starters organized by use case. Missing for 10: documented one-click deploy flow, a catalog of templates or starters for common use cases, details on what templates include, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI. Then, git push to deploy.
